objective: Milestone 13: Residence Eligibility, Operations Metrics Aggregator and Brochure Section Parser

tasks.description: Implement applicant residence country eligibility evaluator to evaluate applicant country of residence against opportunity geographic eligibility constraints (e.g. domestic applicants, bilateral student exchange agreements, regional resident quotas like ASEAN/EU/Belt and Road, and international students currently residing in China vs abroad).
acceptance_criteria: evaluateResidenceEligibility(applicantProfile, opportunityRules, options) evaluates whether an applicant's country of residence satisfies the opportunity's geographic criteria (allowed countries, excluded countries, regional blocs)
Supports regional blocs (e.g. ASEAN, EU, AFRICAN_UNION, BELT_AND_ROAD, GLOBAL) expanding to standard ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 / alpha-3 country codes
Distinguishes citizenship/nationality requirements from physical country of residence, including 'must currently reside in host country (CN)' vs 'must apply from home country abroad'
Handles unstated or worldwide residence rules cleanly with structured match outcomes and explanatory notes
Pure in-memory domain logic with zero side-effects and comprehensive unit tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/residence-eligibility.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement unified operational health metrics aggregator to synthesize system health across research jobs, outbound delivery queues, monthly spending vs budget caps, and system SLAs into unified dashboard metrics with status indicators (HEALTHY, DEGRADED, CRITICAL).
acceptance_criteria: aggregateOperationsMetrics(inputs, options) aggregates metrics from research collection (job count, failure rate, oldest active job), delivery queues (pending count, dead-letter count, trip count), spending (microdollar spend, budget percentage, throttle state), and database/system health

Computes overall operational status (HEALTHY, DEGRADED, CRITICAL) using deterministic threshold rules (e.g. DLQ > 0 or spending >= 90% trips to DEGRADED, spending >= 100% or circuit breaker OPEN trips to CRITICAL)
Formats bilingual (EN/ZH) summary messages and actionable diagnostic alerts for operator dashboards
Pure in-memory aggregation logic conforming to admin operations interfaces with robust test coverage
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/operations-aggregator.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement multi-format admissions brochure and guideline parser to parse structured text and markdown admissions guides, extracting funding packages, eligibility requirements, application steps, and timeline milestones into candidate opportunity records.
acceptance_criteria: parseBrochureDocument(content, options) extracts structured sections from plain text or markdown admissions brochures (e.g. Program Overview, Scholarship Coverage / Stipend, Eligibility Criteria, Application Documents, Important Dates)
Parses tabular and list-formatted funding details (tuition waiver, accommodation, monthly living allowance in CNY) and matches standard funding tier patterns
Extracts deadline anchors and chronological milestones (application window, interview date, result notification) into normalized ISO date strings
Handles malformed, unstructured, or missing sections gracefully with confidence scores and extraction diagnostics
Pure domain logic with zero external runtime dependencies and comprehensive unit tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/brochure-parser.test.ts && npm run typecheck
